```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r load data, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

re_simulate <- FALSE

b_boxgrid <- readRDS(here("data", "boxgrid.rds"))

fitmort_child_gen_krig_int <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_int.rds"))
fitmort_child_gen_krig <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig.rds"))
```

Simulating responses from fitted models using `type = "predVar"` to get both fixed effect and dispersion variances, to capture uncertainty in predictions for the poisson models. We use these simulations to calculate the posterior probability that the ATE is beneficial (i.e. that the predicted mortality rate under treatment is lower than under control) at each grid point.

Simulations took 789.3 sec (13.2 min) for the generalized kriging model without interaction and 765.641 sec (12.8 min) for the model with interaction. 

```{r simulate responses}

newdat <- cross_join(
  tibble(isTreated_child = c("Treatment", "Control")),
  b_boxgrid
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2],
         pt_year_1to59 = 1000,
         isTreated_child = factor(isTreated_child)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Using type = "predVar" 

if(re_simulate){

  tic("simulations")
  simulated_responses_gen_krig <- simulate(fitmort_child_gen_krig,
                                      type = "predVar",
                                      variances=list(linPred=TRUE,disp=TRUE),
                                      nsim = nsim_input,
                                      newdata = newdat,
                                      seed = 12345
  )
  toc()

  saveRDS(simulated_responses_gen_krig, here("data", "simulated_responses_gen_krig.rds"))

  tic("simulations: interaction")
  simulated_responses_gen_krig_int <- simulate(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
                                      type = "predVar",
                                      variances=list(linPred=TRUE,disp=TRUE),
                                      nsim = nsim_input,
                                      newdata = newdat,
                                      seed = 12345
  )
  toc()

  saveRDS(simulated_responses_gen_krig_int, here("data", "simulated_responses_gen_krig_int.rds"))

} else {
  simulated_responses_gen_krig <- readRDS(here("data", "simulated_responses_gen_krig.rds")) 
  simulated_responses_gen_krig_int <- readRDS(here("data", "simulated_responses_gen_krig_int.rds"))
}

```

```{r post process simulations}

sim2tib <- function(sim_responses, newdat, modelname = NA_character_){
  # convert matrix to tibble and name sim columns
  sim_tibs <- as_tibble(
    sim_responses,
    .name_repair = ~ paste0("sim_", seq_along(.))
  )

  # bind the coordinates / covariates (keep ordering)
  combined <- bind_cols(
    newdat %>% dplyr::select(lon, lat, isTreated_child),
    sim_tibs
  )

  # pivot to long form
  long_preds <- combined %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("sim_"),
      names_to = "sim",
      values_to = "pred"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sim_n = as.integer(sub("^sim_", "", sim))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(lon, lat, isTreated_child, sim_n, pred) %>%
    mutate(model = modelname)

}

full_pred_long <- rbind(
  sim2tib(simulated_responses_gen_krig, newdat, "gen_krig"),
  sim2tib(simulated_responses_gen_krig_int, newdat, "gen_krig_int")
)

full_pred <- full_pred_long %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(lon, lat, sim_n, model), 
  names_from = isTreated_child, names_prefix = "pred_",
  values_from = pred)

full_pred <- full_pred %>%
  mutate(ate_resp = pred_Treatment - pred_Control)

saveRDS(full_pred, here("data", "full_pred_sim.rds"))
```

```{r}

post_prob <- full_pred %>%
  group_by(lon, lat, model) %>%
  summarise(neg_ate = sum(ifelse(ate_resp < 0, 1, 0)),
  total_ate = n(),
  prob = neg_ate/total_ate,
  .groups = "drop")

post_prob_map <- post_prob %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = proj_crs)

saveRDS(post_prob_map, here("data", "post_prob_dat.rds"))

```

```{r calculate sim summ metrics}

summary(full_pred$ate_resp)

summary(post_prob$prob)

ggplot(data = post_prob, aes(color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = prob, y = model))

```

```{r plot sim dist}
sim_box <- ggplot(data = full_pred, aes(group = model, color = model, y = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = ate_resp)) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

sim_box_no_ol <- ggplot(data = full_pred, aes(group = model, color = model, y = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = ate_resp), outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y = element_blank())

sim_box | sim_box_no_ol +
  plot_annotation(title = "Summary across all simulations, all grid points")
```

```{r plot sample sim}
sim_sub_idx <- sample(1:nsim_input, size = 10, replace = FALSE)
sim_sub <- full_pred %>%
  dplyr::filter(sim_n %in% sim_sub_idx)

ggplot(data = sim_sub, aes(group = sim_n, color = model, y = factor(sim_n))) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = ate_resp), outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 2) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  ggtitle("10 random simulations")

```
